title: Pinball Wizards
section: The Merchandising Art of Star Wars
description: Pinball Wizards can beat back the Empire in a smashing STAR WARS pinball game from Data East. The flashy back-glass art (front) by Markus is actually printed on a plastic sheet. Fantasy artist William Stout contributed this heroic Luke on Hoth painting (back) for a Chalfont British recording of the symphonic suite from THE EMPIRE STRIKES BACK.
